 Versus

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SHREE CHANDRASHEKHAR  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RATNAKER BHENGRA For the Appellant : Mr. Sumeet Gadodia, Advocate  Mrs. Aanya, Advocate  Mr. Prakash Narayan, Advocate  Mr. Ankit Kumar, Advocate For the State of Jharkhand: Mr. Ashok Kumar Yadav, Sr. SC-I  Mr. Anish Kumar Mishra, AC to Sr. SC-I  ---------
Order No. 06 /Dated: 19th January 2023

The writ petition filed by Hi-Tech Heritage Limited seeking a direction upon the Deputy-Commissioner, Saraikela-Kharsawan to pay compensation for 66.5 decimals land has been dismissed on the ground that the appellant has alternative recourse under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (in short, "Land Acquisition Act").
Shorn of unnecessary details, we would record that no dispute on claim of the appellant to have right, title and interest of the aforesaid 66.5 decimals land has been raised in any manner whatsoever.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: To add to this, we would indicate that Mr. Sumeet Gadodia, the learned counsel for the appellant makes a statement on instructions that the aforesaid land is free from all encumbrances and no private person has raised any dispute of any nature.

We further find that the stand taken by the respondent no.2 that the acquisition for 66.5 decimals land for which a preliminary notification dated 29th December 2018 under section 11(1) of the Land Acquisition Act was issued has lapsed is based on the fact that amount of compensation was not provided by the State of Jharkhand.

In this connection, our attention has been drawn to Hi-Tech Heritage Limited Through Its ... vs The State Of Jharkhand And Others on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60285272/
1 communication dated 8th October 2022 from the District Land Acquisition Officer,
Saraikella-Kharsawan.

entities.text: Hi-Tech Heritage Limited Through Its ... vs The State Of Jharkhand And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This also seems to be an admitted position that over or some part of 66.5 decimals land road has been constructed and by virtue of that the appellant has been dispossessed of the said property.

The aforesaid being the fact-situation obtaining in the present case, the Secretary, Department of Road Construction, Government of Jharkhand shall file an affidavit within one week why compensation at the rate as indicated in the Award dated 15th November 2017 with statutory interest be not paid to the appellant.

entities.text: Department of Road Construction, Government of Jharkhand
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Post this matter on 7th February 2023 under the heading "Final Disposal".
